Commentary.Commentary: Courtesy of tonight’s win, Pakistan stay in contention for the semi-finals with all to play for in their last group game. Whereas South Africa needs to beat the Netherlands on Sunday in order to seal their spot in the semis. As we get to the business end of the tournament, Group 1 action resumes tomorrow with a doubleheader. It will be Ireland taking on New Zealand first and that will begin at 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT) followed by Australia taking on Afghanistan at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT) in the second game of the day. As always you can join us for the build-ups that begin much sooner. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan says that they performed well and he is happy with the win. Adds that they were not up to the mark but Haris came on and set the momentum. Further says that everyone is his best player and everyone is the match winner. Says that the first two losses cost them but the way they played their last two was amazing. Ends by saying that cricket is a funny game and anything can happen.

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa says that he is disappointed with the bowling and fielding towards the end. Adds that they shouldn't have allowed Pakistan to post a formidable score after them being 5 wickets down. Shares that they need to ask questions of themselves and come up with answers and solutions. He Credits Pakistan with the way they batted and bowled. Reckons that weather is not an excuse since the bowlers practice with the wet ball as well. Feels that they did not adapt quickly and bowled with the shorter side of the ground instead of using the bigger side. Ends by saying that the game against Netherlands is a big game for them and they will try to take learnings from tonight's game to that game on Sunday.

Shadab Khan wins the Player of the Match for his all-round performance. He says that he has done this is PSL as well, Adds that this is an international game and so this is the best one. Further says that the pitch was a good one and a bit slower compared to Perth and has a spin as well. Mentions that he is happy to bat anywhere. Ends by saying that he is happy with the win and contribute to the team.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the night, Pakistan were off to a shaky start having been reduced to 43-4. Fifties by Shadab Khan and Iftikhar Ahmed helped Pakistan swing momentum in their way and post a challenging total on the board. South Africa were sharp with the new ball, but leaked apleanty in the death overs.

A complete performance by Pakistan! It was Shaheen Afridi who set the tone for Pakistan with two wickets in his first two overs. Just when a partnership was blossoming, Shadab Khan removed both set batters in the eighth over just before the rain intervened. With 73 needed off the final five overs, Pakistan held their nerves and successfully defended the total.

South Africa too lost one of their openers early when Quinton de Kock was dismissed in the first over. Temba Bavuma and Aiden Markram then steadied the ship and kept the scoreboard ticking. With the threat of rain looming large, South Africa lost both batters in one over to put them in more misery. The revised target of 142 proved to be a lot and as a result, South Africa fell short by 33 runs.

Pakistan continue their domination over South Africa in the T20 World Cup. What a dominatng performance by Pakistan. First with the blade and then with the ball in hand. Although, with some luck on their side as the rain gods played a major part which forced the DLS method to intervene. So, Pakistan keep their hopes alive to make it to the Semis.

FOUR! Up and over! South Africa end their innings on a positive note but in a losing cause.It is full, outside off. Lungi Ngidi gets under it and lofts it over mid off. A couple of bounces and over the ropes.
A single now as Shamsi punches this length delivery to covers.
Tabraiz Shamsi is the last batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! South Africa are falling like a pack of cards. They lose their ninth wicket. A short ball, on off. Anrich Nortje stands tall and heaves it down to long on. This goes high in the air rather than travelling the distance and Mohammad Haris grabs it with both hands in the deep.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Haris b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball, wide of off. Anrich Nortje looks to chase it but misses.
Lungi Ngidi walks in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another one bites the dust. Kagiso Rabada is the man to depart this time. It is full, on off. Anrich Nortje drills it to sweeper cover. The batters take a single but call for the second run as well. Mohammad Nawaz throws it to Haris Rauf at the non-striker's end, who is quick to take the bails off. The replays later confirm that Kagiso Rabada is well short of his crease.
Rauf goes full and outside off. Kagiso Rabada drives it to mid off for a quick single. A direct-hit could've made things interesting.

Naseem Shah cuts the batter into half this time. It is a full ball, around leg stump, Anrich Nortje looks to heave the ground but gets beaten on the inside edge. Fortunately for him, the ball goes past the leg pole.
Length ball, on off. Nortje slices it towards backward point.
Anrich Nortje walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tristan Stubbs tries to break the shackles but has to head back to the pavilion. It is a short ball. Tristan Stubbs stands tall and pulls it to deep square leg from outside off. He does not get the desired distance on it. He hits it staright down the throat of Mohammad Nawaz in the deep who makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Naseem Shah

Commentary.Commentary: Another slower delivery, this time on a shorter length, outside off. Stubbs shuffles and goes for the pull shot. He though gets pinged on his gloves, as the ball rolls out to the off side.
Naseem Shah gice no pace to work with this time. A slower length ball, outside off. Tristan Stubbs looks to pull the trigger but is unable to get it away.
Back of a length, wide of off. Tristan Stubbs shuffles and smacks it down to long on for a brace. 41 needed off 11 balls now.
Full length, on leg. Kagiso Rabada goes back and punches it to mid off for no run.
Kagiso Rabada is the new batter.

OUT! LBW! This is plumb and the umpire agrees as well. Wayne Parnell though takes the review just incase. Wasim hurls in a yorker length delivery, on middle. Wayne Parnell shuffles and tries to paddle it away but misses. He gets pinged on his pads. The review though does not work in his favour, as the Ball Tracking shows three reds. Wayne Parnell walks back cheaply.
Wasim serves a yorker, in the blockhole, at 143 clicks. Stubbs makes room but only to meet Babar Azam at extra cover. They get a single.
Wasim goes full yet again, attacking the pads. Wayne Parnell flicks it to square leg for one.
A yorker this time, on leg, Stubbs goes back and whacks it down to long on but only for a single. He looks a bit frustrated.
Wasim dishes it full, outside off. Wayne Parnell drives it through covers for a single.
It is very full, on off. Wayne Parnell strokes it towards extra covers and scampers across for a single.
Wayne Parnell is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! The crowd roars as Heinrich Klaasen holes out this time. It is full, on off. Heinrich Klaasen looks to heave it across the line but is a bit early into his shot. The ball takes the outside edge and hangs for a while in the air, before Mohammad Wasim gathers it with both hands at short third man. Pakistan have their noses in front here.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Wasim b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Heinrich Klaasen goes off side this time but the result is same. It is pitched up, on off. Heinrich Klaasen stands tall and drives it uppishly over extra covers for four more.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Heinrich Klaasen is in his groove. It is full, on the pads, Heinrich Klaasen stays back and flicks it over mid-wicket. One bounce and over the ropes.
Shaheen Afridi now fires in a yorker, right in the blockhole. Stubbs goes bag, digs it out to mid-wicket and crosses.
A length ball, around off. Tristan Stubbs stands tall and whips it down to long on. Both the batters are quick between the wickets and they take two.
FOUR! Shadab misses his length and pays the price. Bowls a low full toss on off, Heinrich Klaasen brings out the switch hit and times it beautifully over backward point for a boundary.
Short and turning into the batter, Tristan Stubbs cuts this one towards backward point for a single.
Flighted on off, Tristan Stubbs backs away to work it on the off side. Finds Babar Azam at extra cover.
Slightly shorter on off, Tristan Stubbs pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
SIX! Brave shot! Flighted outside off, Tristan Stubbs makes room by moving away and smashes this one towards deep cover for his first six of the innings.
Shadab Khan starts off with a shortish delivery on off, Heinrich Klaasen knocks it to cover for a single.
We are back. Pakistan players huddle out in middle. Tristan Stubbs and Heinrich Klaasen walk in again with their blades. Shadab Khan comes to bowl.

UPDATE 5.01 pm IST (11.31 am GMT) - Good news folks, we have a restart time! The covers are finally off. The game will restart at 5.10 pm IST (11.40 am GMT). The game has been reduced to 14 overs. The revised target is142 so South Africa now need 73 from 30 deliveries.

UPDATE 4.34 pm IST (11.04 am GMT) - The drizzle is still on and the umpires are seen having a chat on the ground with umbrellas. The players are waiting near the ropes and the covers are still on. Let's hope for some cricket soon. Fingers crossed.

UPDATE 4.41 pm IST (11.11 am GMT) - Some positive signs! It looks like the covers are coming off now, but the pitch cover still remains intact. The crowd cheers as they are anticipating some action soon. Although, the rain gods continue to be a part of it. The umpires are checking the landing area of the bowler. Fingers crossed!

UPDATE 4.12 pm IST (10.42 am GMT)- The rain is coming down a bit heavier now. The umpires converge, but it looks like the play will go on. Keeping in the mind, the DLS method, South Africa are 16 runs behind at the moment after losing wickets in quick succession. OH WAIT! The inevitable has happened and the covers are on now. So, Pakistan have an advantage as they head out of the field. We hope it is just a passing shower and we back with some action soon.
Short and outiside off, Tristan Stubbs looks to play this fine on the off side but fails to pierce the gap and finds Mohammad Wasim at short third man. Three dots to end the over by Mohammad Nawaz.
Fullish delivery on middle, Tristan Stubbs does not find the gap and hits it straight to extra cover.
Flighted on off, Tristan Stubbs pushes it to Babar Azam at extra cover.
Flatter on leg, Heinrich Klaasen goes back and works it to long on for a single.
Full on off, Heinrich Klaasen gets forward and plays it towards extra cover.
Mohammad Nawaz starts off with a shortish delivery outside off, Tristan Stubbs knocks it off the back foot to long on for a single.
Short and turning away from the batter, Heinrich Klaasen punches it to extra cover.
Short and outside off, Tristan Stubbs cuts this one to deep cover and gets off the mark with a single.
Googly on middle, Tristan Stubbs gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Tristan Stubbs is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Flatter on middle, Aiden Markram misjudges the length and goes on the backfoot to work it on the leg side. The ball slides on with the angle and crashes into the stumps. Both set batters back in the hut for South Africa. Shadab Khan has brought Pakistan right back into the game
Short and outside off Heinrich Klaasen punches it off the backfoot to deep cover for a single and opens his account.
Heinrich Klaasen is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shadab Khan strikes with his first delivery. Flighted outside off, turns away from the batter. Temba Bavuma gets an outside edge as he tried to work it fine and Mohammad Rizwan does the rest. A timely wicket for Pakistan as Temba Bavuma was threatening to take the game away from them.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Haris Rauf has been wayward with his lengths in this over. Bowls this one wide outside off, Aiden Markram stands tall and slaps this one wide of mid off for another boundary. A 17-run over by Haris Rauf comes to an end,
Short and outside off, Temba Bavuma cuts it to the right of backward point. Shadab Khan dives to his right and keeps it to one.
Cutter on off, Aiden Markram drills this one towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Fuller outside off, Aiden Markram frees his arms and fetches this one from outside off. Drives this one nicely between extra cover and mid off for his third boundary.
Slower outside off, Temba Bavuma clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Temba Bavuma welcomes Haris Rauf with a massive six. Full and outside off, Temba Bavuma moves to the off side and helps this one behind square for an 85-metre six.
Change. Haris Rauf (1-0-20-0) is back into the attack now.

Banged in short outside off, Temba Bavuma opens the bat face and guides this one towards backward point for a single. Temba Bavuma signals that he got distracted by the towel falling off from Mohammad Wasim's backside.
Short of a length delivery on off, Temba Bavuma pulls this one between mid on and mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Good-length delivery outside off, Aiden Markram makes room and punches this one to extra cover for a single.
Cutter on middle, Temba Bavuma knocks it on the off side and takes a quick single.
Short on off, Temba Bavuma defends it off the back foot on the leg side.
FOUR! A loosener to start off with by Mohammad Wasim. Short and wide outside off, Temba Bavuma frees his arms and dispatches this one towards deep cover for a boundary.
Back of a length and on leg, Aiden Markram moves forward to play at it but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls back towards the keeper.
Shorter and slower one, outside off. Aiden Markram gets in two minds and defends it with soft hands in the end.
On a length and on off, Aiden Markram knocks it to mid on. The misfield allows the batters to take two runs.
Slightly shorter one, slower too. Aiden Markram gets in two minds but leaves it alone in the end.
Touch-fuller delivery, on off. Aiden Markram defends it to point.
Good length and on off, Temba Bavuma taps it to backward point for one.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for South Africa. Slightly shorter and on off, Aiden Markram thumps it over mid on for another boundary!
FOUR! On a length and on off, Aiden Markram drives it through extra covers for a boundary!

On a length and on off, Temba Bavuma defends it back to the bowler. There's a huge mix-up between the batters. He stops and decides to go again. He dives it and the fielder makes a direct hit. Replay shows he was just in. Lucky for Temba Bavuma!

Is this a run out? Pakistan seem to be convinced. The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays later confirm that Temba Bavuma makes his ground as the bails come off. The big screen shows NOT OUT.
FOUR! Shorter one and on off, Temba Bavuma rocks back and caresses it over point for a boundary!
Wide! This one lands shorter and on leg, Temba Bavuma lets it go.

South Africa are under immense pressure. They have already lost two wickets inside four overs. They desperately need their batters to focus on building stands for now, which can certainly allow them to go for the kill later on, if Pakistan's bowling attack is unable to capitalize on their birght start here.
Good length and on off, Temba Bavuma taps it to backward point and calls for two. The fielder throws it to the keeper who stumps it. Replay shows that Temba Bavuma was well in.
FOUR! Shorter one on leg, Temba Bavuma uses the pace of the ball and helps it through fine leg for a boundary!
Good length and on off, Aiden Markram flicks it to mid on. A dot to end the over. Good over for Pakistan!
On a length and on off, Aiden Markram eases it towards the off side.
Aiden Markram comes in at number 4 for South Africa.

OUT! TAKEN! Huge wicket for Pakistan and South Africa are two down now. Shorter one on off, Rilee Rossouw looks to play at it but gets a top edge. The ball carries towards third man. Naseem Shah in the deep takes a good catch to his left at the boundary line. Pressure piling up on South Africa now!
Commentary.Howout: c Naseem Shah b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: Good length again, on off. Rilee Rossouw flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Bowls it fuller and outside off, Rilee Rossouw leaves it alone.
On a length and on off, Temba Bavuma looks to defend it but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls towards short fine leg. They cross.
Good length again, on off. Temba Bavuma taps it to mid on for a quick single.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Temba Bavuma pulls it over mid-wicket for a one-bounce boundary!
On a length and on leg, Rilee Rossouw flicks it to square leg for one.
SIX! Excellent timing. Slightly shorter and on leg, Rilee Rossouw uses his wrist and helps it over backward square leg for a maximum.
Good length shaping it away, Rilee Rossouw eases it to covers. Dot.
A short ball, on off. Bavuma hops and pushes it to point for one.
Wide! This one lands outside leg, Temba Bavuma looks to flick it but misses.
Rilee Rossouw walks in at number 3. Also, Naseem Shah will be sharing the new ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Quinton de Kock walks out for a duck. Slightly shorter one, on off, Quinton de Kock looks to pull it but doesn't connect well. It carries towards mid-wicket. Mohammad Haris adjusts himself and takes a good catch over his head. Pakistan have an early and a much needed breakthrough in the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Haris b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: Make it four dots. On a length and on leg, Quinton de Kock looks to heave it but misses. The ball goes just over the stumps. Close!
Three dots now. Good length and on off, Quinton de Kock defends it back towards the bowler.
Slightly shorter with some extra bounce, Quinton de Kock looks to defend it but misses.
Good length again, on leg. Quinton de Kock eases it to the fielder at square leg.
Shaheen Afridi starts with a length ball on middle, Temba Bavuma flicks it to mid on and gets off the mark. They cross.
